newsitem.title: USA: Northrop Grumman names ESG as subcontractor.
newsitem.headline: Northrop Grumman names ESG as subcontractor.

text.p: Northrop Grumman Corp on Wednesday said it has named a German company, ESG Elektroniksystem-und Logistik-GmbH, as its primary European subcontractor on a proposed Joint STARS ground support system.

The system is one option being developed for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization's Alliance Ground Surveillance (AGS) program. NATO is expected to make a production decision in the fall of 1997, Northrop Grumman said in a statement.
Joint STARS is a wide-area surveillance system housed in an aircraft. It provides a clear picture of the ground for peacekeeping and crisis management situations.
